Evaluate Conditional Expectations

Source: R/eval_conditional.R
eval_conditional.Rd

eval_conditional() calculates Individual Conditional Expectation (ICE) curves from a fitted model for a single predictor variable.

Usage

eval_conditional(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mid'
eval_conditional(
  object,
  variable,
  data = NULL,
  resolution = 100L,
  max.nsamples = 500L,
  seed = NULL,
  type = c("response", "link"),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'mids'
eval_conditional(
  object,
  variable,
  data = NULL,
  resolution = 100L,
  max.nsamples = 500L,
  seed = NULL,
  type = c("response", "link"),
  ...
)

Arguments

object

a "mid" or "mids" object.

...

additional arguments passed to methods.

variable

character string naming the predictor variable to vary.

data

a data.frame containing observations for ICE evaluation. Extracted automatically from object when omitted.

resolution

number of evaluation grid points for continuous variables.

max.nsamples

maximum number of observations to evaluate. Larger datasets are randomly subsampled.

seed

optional integer seed for subsampling.

type

character: "response" (default) or "link".

Value

For a "mid" object, an object of class "midcon" containing observed, conditional, variable, values, and ids. For a "mids" collection, a collection of class c("midcons", "midlist").

Details

For each observation \(\mathbf{x}_i\), the ICE curve evaluates the model across a grid of values \(x'\) for the target variable while holding all other predictors \(\mathbf{x}_{i,\setminus j}\) fixed:

$$f_{\text{ICE}}(x') = g(x', \mathbf{x}_{i,\setminus j})$$

See also

interpret, plot.midcon, ggmid.midcon

Examples

data(airquality, package = "datasets")
aq <- na.omit(airquality)
mid <- interpret(Ozone ~ (Solar.R + Wind + Temp)^2, data = aq, lambda = 0.5)
#> 'model' not passed: response variable in 'data' is used

eval_conditional(mid, variable = "Wind", data = aq, max.nsamples = 30L)
#> number of observations exceeds 'max.nsamples': a sample of 30 observations from 'data' is used
#> 
#> MID Conditional Expectation for 'Wind' (30 Observations)
#> 
#> Grid Values: 2.3000, 2.4859, 2.6717, ...
#> 
#> Observed Head:
#>   .id    yhat Ozone Solar.R Wind Temp
#> 1  76  20.903     7      48 14.3   80
#> 2  30  83.775   115     223  5.7   79
#> 3 116  49.986    45     212  9.7   79
#> 4  99 124.851   122     255  4.0   89
#> 5 142  25.830    24     238 10.3   68
#> 6 143  47.160    16     201  8.0   82
